facets.description: Google updateEvent (lines 254-256): the fallback find() compares against an externalCalendarId that is already falsy, so selectedCalendar is undefined instead of the destination calendar's externalId
Google deleteEvent (lines 314-317): the same dead find() fallback leaves calendarId undefined or falls back to 'primary' instead of using the destination calendar's externalId

answer.reasoning: The labelers disagree only on s_6293a6a3 and s_0a0cb899. Both are filed on deleteEvent. Both also say outright that updateEvent has the same defect: s_6293a6a3 says "Same dead condition as updateEvent" and s_0a0cb899 says "deleteEvent repeats the same dead fallback as updateEvent". Each phrase claims the bug also exists in updateEvent. That is the same kind of claim as "this also happens in Update", which counts. It is not just a vague "elsewhere", so I count F1 for both. Someone could argue the updateEvent mention is only a point of comparison, so this is not fully settled. s_02b6e8cb and s_3ab53f11 talk only about updateEvent. s_f5b59d63, s_a907ae4b and s_ac235e40 name deleteEvent and its lines explicitly.
